note: governance T13 (spec section 10.1): every non-view external of the fifteen artifacts (plan T32: + the six regulated kinds 8-13, each its base kind's rows and the eight control entries; + the router's eight control ops), one class each, read by test/governance/SelectorAudit.t.sol against ./out. BIT(n): a holder of bit n, the feature on. OWNER: the owner (revokeRole and setGrant also a live grantor of a delegable grant). HOLDER_OWN: the caller's own role or pending ownership. OWN_BALANCE: the caller's own balance or an allowance its holder granted. SIGNED: a signature of the subject it acts for (a self-call or the DEX's puller only inside a signed settlement). FACTORY: the factory, once. PERMISSIONLESS(reason): anyone, for the reason given. `error`: what a stranger's call with zero arguments reverts with; required on BIT, OWNER, HOLDER_OWN, FACTORY. Written once, then classified by hand; never regenerated to go green. Group 3h T59: the six PQZ proof-carrying entries of kinds 4, 5, 12 and 13 (direct and signed) take `bytes32 ownTag` in their args tuple (pqz-proof-path spec §3.2); their signatures moved in place, every class unchanged (the rows before: test/vectors/legacy/ua-mtx-merge/3h/selector_audit.json).
